henry.title: Moon Math: Distance, Days and Fractions
henry.intro: Use numbers from the real Moon trip. (About 15 minutes.)
steps: 📖 Read each chunk. Tap 🔊 if you want.
✅ Check the Challenge if you have time.
links: NASA Space Place: All About the Moon
Find the Quick Facts. How far is the Moon on average?

passage.text: 🌕 The Moon is about 240,000 miles from Earth. That is a long drive: about 10 times around Earth at the equator.
passage.q: About how far is the Moon?

passage.text: 🚀 Apollo 11 launched on July 16 and splashed down on July 24. The whole trip was 8 days.
passage.q: How many days was the trip?

passage.text: 👣 Armstrong and Aldrin walked on the Moon for about 2 hours. That is 1/4 of an 8-hour school day.
passage.q: What fraction of an 8-hour day is 2 hours?

passage.text: 📡 Radio signals travel at the speed of light. A message to the Moon takes about 1.3 seconds each way. Round trip talk: about 3 seconds.
passage.q: About how long for a round-trip radio chat?

words: how far apart two places are
a part of a whole, like 1/4
worksheet: The Moon is about ______ miles away. Circle: 24,000 / 240,000 / 2,400,000
Moon walk ≈ 2 hours. Fraction of an 8-hour day: ____. Circle: 1/2 / 1/4 / 1/8
A one-way radio delay is about 1.3 s. Round trip ≈ ____ s. Circle: 1 / 3 / 10
If a rocket goes 1,000 miles each hour, hours to go 8,000 miles: ____
henry.challenge: The Moon's diameter is about 2,000 miles. Earth's is about 8,000. What fraction of Earth's diameter is the Moon? (2,000 ÷ 8,000 = ?)
